about: List prices in USD per 1M tokens. Rules are tried in order, the first whose regex is found in the model name wins; a model no rule names prices at the fallback, the most expensive tier, so a new model reads as expensive rather than free. cache_read is a flat rate where a rule gives one, else cache_read_ratio of input. Cache writes are input times cache_write_5m or cache_write_1h by TTL. An estimate for comparing work, not an invoice; the prices drift.
